definition: a continuous pain in the head; headache.
example: ಮೂರ್ಧವ್ಯಾಧಿಯಿಂದ ಬಳಲುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಅವನು ವೈದ್ಯರ ಬಳಿ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: Suffering from a continuous headache, he went to the doctor.

definition: the act of digging the earth; excavation.
example_en: The workers dug up the earth.

definition: the duty, office of a postman.
example_en: He was doing the duty of a postman in the village.

definition: the daily religious service in a temple.
example_en: The priests performed the daily religious service in the temple.

definition: the pointed end of a needle.
example_en: The pointed tip of the needle passed easily through the cloth.

definition: a crying or shouting aloud for a trivial pain.
example: ಸಣ್ಣ ನೋವಿಗೂ ಅವನು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಆರವಾರ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He made a loud outcry even over a small pain.

definition: (agricultural land) to be prepared for being sowed with seeds.
example_en: Before the rainy season, the field became ready for sowing.

definition: an ophthalmic disease.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅರಮ ಎಂಬ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: He got the eye disease called arama.

definition: any of various plant diseases caused by fungi or bacteria and characterised by decay.
example_en: The crop was completely destroyed by the rot disease.

definition: (the female reproductive cell) to be impregnated successfully.
example_en: After the treatment, she conceived.

definition: permission; approval; assent; consent.
example: ತಂದೆಯ ಒಪ್ಪಿತ ಸಿಕ್ಕಮೇಲೆಯೇ ಅವಳು ಪ್ರವಾಸ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: Only after getting her father's permission did she go on the trip.

definition: liable to or deserving punishment; punishable; culpable.
example: ಇಂತಹ ಅಪರಾಧ ಶಿಕ್ಷಾರ್ಹ ಎಂದು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಧೀಶರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The judge said that such a crime is punishable.

definition: a binding agreement.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಒಂದು ಬಾಂಡು ಬರೆದು ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Both of them wrote and signed a binding agreement.

definition: (hist.) a monetary coin of one rupee.
example_en: There was an old hukkeri coin in grandfather's box.

definition: lack of self control over one's body or action, lack of judgement, from wrath, sorrow, fear, joy, etc.).
example_en: In his fury, he lost control over his body and actions.

definition: having irregular surface.
example_en: The surface of that stone was irregular.

definition: to bind - a) to tie together; make fast or tight, as with a rope or band; b) to hold or restrain as if tied or tied down.
example_en: He got the sack tied with a rope.

definition: melodious sounds; pleasant voice.
example_en: The melodious sounds of the birds broke the morning silence.

definition: that which has grown lean, abnormally slender or withered.
example_en: During the drought the cow looked lean and withered.

definition: a man who makes a regular and repeated circuit of an area, town, camp, etc. in guarding; a patrol-man.
example: ಆ ಗಸ್ತಿಗಾರ ಪ್ರತಿ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That patrol-man goes around the street every night.

definition: a large mass of ice and snow that forms in areas where the rate of snowfall constantly exceeds the rate at which the snow melts; a glacier.
example: ಪರ್ವತದ ತುದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ನೀರ್ಗಲ್ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಕರಗುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: A large glacier at the mountain top is slowly melting.

definition: lustre of the body.
example_en: Her bodily lustre attracts everyone's attention.

definition: a manner, sort, variety that is particular or that distinguishes one from another.
example_en: Every cloth has its own distinctive style.

definition: the cardinal number twenty; 20.
example_en: There were twenty coins in that bag.

definition: a person with only one leg; a crippled person.
example_en: That one-legged man walks with the help of a crutch.

definition: the full-moonday.
example_en: On the full-moon day, the moon shines fully.

definition: cold milk.
example_en: They gave cold milk to the child tired from the heat.

definition: in a legislature having two branches, that branch for which representatives are elected by general electorate; the lower house; the Lōka Sabhe or Vidhāna Sabhe.
example_en: That bill was passed in the lower house.

definition: a small village.
example_en: There is a small village at the foot of the hill.

definition: a ruler; a king.
example_en: The king ruled the country with righteousness.

definition: the periphery of a wheel.
example_en: The rim of the cart wheel had worn away.

definition: to be appointed to a position, office, etc.; to be assigned with.
example_en: He was appointed to a new position.

definition: a wild sheep.
example_en: The hunters chased the wild sheep in the forest.

definition: the fresh water fish Puntius kolus.
example_en: The fishermen caught koracha fish in the lake.

definition: hair of the head.
example_en: Her hair was long and shining.

definition: a kind of sugar.
example_en: They sweetened the payasam using sita sugar.

definition: a set of two objects (of the same class); a pair.
example: ಅವನು ಕಿವಿಯೋಲೆಗಳ ಒಂದು ಹೊಳಕೆ ಉಡುಗೊರೆಯಾಗಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He gave a pair of earrings as a gift.

definition: a white kind of Agallochum.
example_en: They were selling white agallochum incense in the shop.

definition: one who is engaged or disposed to serious and wilful crime; a criminal.
example_en: They drove that criminal out of the village.

definition: a kind of animal.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಗುಡಿಗುಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The villagers tell stories about the animal called guḍigumma.

definition: stupidity; slowness of wits.
example_en: Because of his slow wits, he could not understand the lesson.

definition: that which is born in a conch, as a marine mollusc.
example_en: The marine mollusc born in a conch grows inside the shell in the sea.

definition: a dog.
example_en: The hunter took the dog along with him.

definition: immediately; suddenly.
example_en: Hearing the news, she was startled suddenly.

definition: to change so as to fit, conform, make suitable, etc.
example_en: He altered the cloth to fit the measurements and stitched it.

definition: a probing, discerning look.
example_en: The policeman gave the suspicious person a probing, discerning look.

definition: the fact of (a person or thing) belonging to another place, country.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೆರತನದ ಭಾವನೆ ಕಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He felt the sense of belonging to another place in that town.

definition: the act or process of gathering together; collection; accumulation.
example_en: Accumulation of wealth was his life's goal.

definition: a fine, mist like rain; drizzle.
example_en: In the evening, a fine drizzle fell from the sky.

definition: to move unsteadily, from back to forth, from side to side or up and down.
example_en: Because of the liquor, he was moving unsteadily as he walked.

definition: weakness in the body caused by wound or disease.
example: ಗಾಯದ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಲೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: Weakness appeared in his body after the wound.

definition: a place where an army has camped.
example_en: The army's camping place was at the foot of the hill.

definition: a coin not in currency.
example_en: That old coin is not in currency now.

definition: the clover plant Trifolium pratense with flowers in reddish, ball-shaped heads, grown for fodder and forage; red-clover.
example_en: They give red-clover grass as fodder to the cattle.

definition: to cause to flow or leak out slowly.
example_en: They let the blood slowly flow out from the wound.

definition: to soak (clothes) in water.
example_en: Before washing, she soaked the clothes in water.

definition: that which has a very pungent smell.
example_en: That medicine had a very pungent smell.

definition: to make a voluntary movement from one place (to another).
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಅವನು ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೊರಟನು.
example_en: He set off to his village at six in the morning.

definition: any of saltwater crustaceans of Cirripedia class that are attached or parasitic in the adult stage, with slender, bristly appendages for gathering food; cirriped.
example_en: A cirriped is stuck to the rock.

definition: an argument offered in disagreement, opposition, refusal or disapproval.
example_en: He raised an argument in opposition to my words.

definition: to see both sides (of the same thing).
example_en: The wise man sees both sides of every matter.

definition: a flat, broad, plain bracelet.
example_en: She had worn a plain, flat bracelet.

definition: a younger brother.
example_en: His younger brother is studying in the town.

definition: a place, building where a person normally lives in; living quarters.
example_en: Her living quarters are in a small village.

definition: the codition of being mixed, merged or united (with another).
example: ಎರಡು ಬಣ್ಣಗಳ ಪ್ರಯುಕ್ತ ಮಿಶ್ರಣದಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಬಣ್ಣ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: A new colour resulted from the merging of the two colours.

definition: a blend of different perfumes.
example_en: A blend of different perfumes had spread in that worship hall.

definition: a female attendant.
example_en: The female attendants came to the palace along with the queen.

definition: unexpectedly; accidentally.
example_en: He met my friend accidentally.

definition: the quality that delights the eyes; beauty; charm.
example_en: Her charm drew everyone's attention.

definition: an association of Arab merchants.
example_en: The merchants of the Arab association had gathered at the port.

definition: a feeling of intentness or concern about something; interest.
example: ಆ ಹೊಸ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಕತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: He has a keen interest in that new subject.

definition: a deep, torturing sense of guilt felt over a wrong that one has done; self-reproach.
example: ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮಱುಗುಹ ಕಾಡತೊಡಗಿತು.
example_en: After making the mistake, deep self-reproach began to torment him.

definition: (dial.) a baby or child.
example_en: Since the baby was crying, the mother picked it up.

definition: a nerve carrying a message toward the central nervous system or brain; an afferent nerve.
example_en: The afferent nerve carries sensation from the skin to the brain.

definition: the condition of being arrested, imprisoned; a being under the possession or custody of.
example_en: The thief was kept in police custody.

definition: the military forces of a nation, exclusive of the navy and the air force; army.
example_en: The army had surrounded that town.

definition: the act of doing.
example_en: The doing of this work was very difficult.

definition: a path or road.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಭಾಟೆ ಕಾಡಿನ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The path leading to the village was in the middle of the forest.

definition: a compost - a) a mixture; a compound; b) a mixture of decomposing vegetable refuse, manure, etc. for fertilising and conditioning soil.
example_en: The farmer applied compost manure to the field.

definition: the state of being toothless; toothlessness.
example_en: Toothlessness is a common problem for the elderly.

definition: a large motor vehicle, having a long body, equipped with seats or benches for passengers; a bus.
example_en: The school children travelled by bus.

definition: the act or an instance of emanating from within or coming out; emanation.
example_en: An emanation of blood was seen from the wound.

definition: to load with a burden; to place a burden on.
example_en: He loaded heavy sacks onto the bullocks.

definition: which day or time.
example_en: Tell me which day or time you will come.

definition: that is remaining; left or left over.
example: ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಹಣ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: After all the work was finished, the remaining money was left over.

definition: to crush; to squeeze.
example_en: She crushed the leaf in her hand.

definition: lack of defence; inability to defend; helplessness; defencelessness.
example: ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೈನಿಕರಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಅರಕ್ಷಣ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Without soldiers at the border, the defencelessness of that region became clear.

definition: a fever caused by phlegm.
example_en: He lay in bed all week with a fever caused by phlegm.

definition: a drop oftear.
example_en: A drop of tear slipped down from her eye.

definition: to look very bright, brilliant.
example_en: The moon shone brilliantly in the sky.

definition: any of the very widely distributed group Bacteria of microscopic prokaryotic mainly single-celled organisms, many of which are symbiotic or pathogenic in animals and plants; a bacterium.
example_en: Bacteria grow in dirty water.

definition: a highly contagious virus infection causing fever, severe aching, and catarrh, often occurring in epidemics; influenza.
example_en: Influenza afflicted many people in the village.

definition: (pl.) both the (rival) groups, teams or parties.
example_en: Both the rival parties signed the agreement.

definition: the plant Mitragyna parvifolia (=Stephegyne parvifolia) of Rubiaceae family; water cadamba.
example_en: Water cadamba trees had grown on the riverbank.

definition: an adultrated thing; a mixture of different things.
example: ಆ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕ್ಕರೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೇರೆ ಪದಾರ್ಥ ಬೆರೆಸಿದ ಕಲಿಗಲ ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In that shop they were selling an adulterated mixture with other substances mixed into the sugar.

definition: a summary of the subject-matter of a book (usu. a list of the titles of chapters etc. with corresponding page number); a list of contents; an index.
example_en: Look at the table of contents of the book first.

definition: a bent or curving part.
example_en: The bent part of that pipe was visible.

definition: the spike of the ear of a plant (as rāgi, jowar etc.).
example_en: The spike of the ragi plant has grown well.

definition: that which is comfortable, solacing or bringing welfare.
example_en: There was not a bit of solace in those words.

definition: the act or an instance of swallowing (hastily or in large amounts); a devouring.
example: ಆತನ ಆಹಾರ ನಿಗರಣ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯಪಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: Everyone was surprised seeing his devouring of food.

definition: a person who greedily eats too much; a voracious man; a glutton.
example: ಆ ಆಶಿರ ಒಂದೇ ಕುಳಿತಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡೀ ತಟ್ಟೆ ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: That glutton emptied the whole plate in one sitting.

definition: a mine - a) a large excavation made in the earth, from which to extract metallic ores, coal, precious stones, salt or certain other minerals; b) any great source of supply.
example_en: Coal is extracted from that mine.

definition: the tip of the tongue.
example_en: The tip of his tongue burned from the spicy masala.

definition: the act of dallying; flirting, toying or trifling; dalliance.
example_en: Their flirtatious dalliance was noticed by everyone.

definition: the act of proceeding, going, moving in an orderly manner.
example_en: The devotees performed a circumambulation around the temple.

definition: a foolish widow.
example: ಆಕೆಯನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹುಚ್ಚುಮುಂಡೆ ಎಂದು ಗೇಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Everyone used to mock her as a foolish widow.

definition: a kind of creeper.
example_en: The kombeyabaḷḷi creeper had coiled around the tree.

definition: a small hand-held toy, that makes a low rattling sound when spun.
example_en: She held the rattle toy in her hand and spun it.

definition: a female singer.
example_en: The female singer sang a lullaby to the child.

definition: won; conquered.
example_en: The enemy's army returned defeated.

definition: having little or no hair on the scalp; bald.
example_en: He, with a bald head, wore a hat.

definition: the plant Prunus mahaleb of Rosaceae family.
example_en: The mahaleb plant grows on the mountain slope.

definition: a frozen rain or grain of ice falling from the clouds; hailstone.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅಂಬುದಫಲ ಬಿದ್ದು ಬೆಳೆ ಹಾನಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hailstones fell along with the rain and damaged the crops.

definition: the quality of being sticky; stickiness (as of an oil, grease, etc.).
example_en: The stickiness of the oil clung to my hand.

definition: a young one of an animal.
example_en: The kitten was drinking milk.

definition: a horse's trot.
example_en: The horse crossed the field at a trot.

definition: to receive (salary, wages, etc.) for one's labour or service; to earn.
example_en: He worked in the company and earned a salary.

definition: a region unsuitable for cultivation and inhabiting, the entire extent being covered by layers of sand and receiving no or very little rain; a desert.
example_en: Camels travel easily in the desert.

definition: of or having dark blue colour.
example_en: She was wearing a saree of dark blue colour.

definition: (geol.) the angle a stratum of rock makes with a horizontal plane; a dip.
example_en: The geologist measured the dip of the rock stratum.

definition: the act of meddling, interfering into another's or otherś affair without being asked to; officiousness causing annoyance to others.
example_en: His meddling spoiled my work.

definition: a girl or woman as she is related to either or both parents; a female descendant; a daughter.
example_en: That daughter was serving her parents.

definition: the border of a cloth.
example_en: The border of the sari was woven with golden threads.

definition: a person whose profession is designing and drawing up plans for houses; a house-architect.
example: ಆ ಗೃಹಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That house-architect designed our home.

definition: (used to modify the verbs, blow, strike, fall, etc.) with a repeated, heavy sound.
example_en: The thunder crashed heavily and repeatedly in the sky.

definition: the slope, ridge, slope or flank of a mountain.
example_en: The waterfall was flowing beautifully on the mountain slope.

definition: a small, flat, wingless insect with sucking mouthparts, parasitic in the hair of humans; the head louse (Pediculus humanus capitis order; Anoplura).
example_en: A head louse was found in the child's hair.

definition: joy; delight; entertainment; amusement.
example_en: Seeing the new house, she felt joy.

definition: the state of being astonished; great amazement; astonishment.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಬಿಸದಳ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: On hearing that news, great astonishment came over her.

definition: the act of going or running (away from).
example_en: Seeing the enemy's retreat, the soldiers rejoiced.

definition: the revenue department of the state that collects taxes.
example_en: The farmers went to the revenue office to pay taxes.

definition: that of which a thing consists; physical matter or material; substance.
example_en: There was no substance in his words.

definition: a wilful disregard, disrespect; slight.
example: ಅವನ ಏಳಾಲದ ವರ್ತನೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇಸರ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His disrespectful, disdainful behavior annoyed everyone.

definition: to become black; to beome charred (as from excess heat); to become dark or darker.
example_en: The cloth became black in the sun.

definition: a short sound made by pressing the front portion of the tongue to the root of the mouth and releasing suddenly (while expressing the joy, enjoying a good taste, etc.).
example: ಸಿಹಿ ತಿಂದ ಮಗು ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ಚಪ್ಪರಣೆ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The child clicked its tongue in delight after eating the sweet.

definition: the plant Wrightia zeylanica ( = W. antidysentrica) tinctoria of Apocynceae family.
example_en: The bhadrayava plant is cultivated for medicinal use.

definition: a person who lives near another; a neighbour.
example_en: Our neighbour is a very helpful person.

definition: a device having a cone and a pipe connected at the small end, for pouring liquids into containrs that have small mouths; a funnel.
example_en: He poured the oil into the bottle through the funnel.

definition: the state of emotional ecstasy or being greatly agitated by strong feelings.
example: ಗೆಲುವಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಆತನಿಗೆ ಜಪಾಟಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news of victory, he was seized with great agitation of joy.

definition: a male goat; he-goat.
example_en: There was a he-goat in the farmer's shed.

definition: a doctor in the system of medicine developed by Muslim; a yunani (unani) physician.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಜನರು ಹಕೀಮನ ಬಳಿ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಗೆ ಹೋದರು.
example_en: The village people went to the unani physician for treatment.

definition: strong dislike;hatred.
example: ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಪಡಿತನ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A strong hatred toward her grew in his mind.

definition: the plant Nicotiana tabacum of Solanaceae family, widely cultivated for its leaves, used in making cigarettes, snuff, etc.; tobacco.
example_en: The farmer is growing tobacco in his field.

definition: the crucifying of Jesus or a representation of this as in painting; crucifixion.
example_en: That painting depicts the crucifixion of Jesus.

definition: speed in using one's hand skilfully; dexterity.
example_en: The magician's hand speed left everyone speechless.

definition: the state of being bewildered or utterly confused.
example: ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪಿಂಜ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: On hearing the sudden news, he became utterly confused.

definition: a fever caused by extreme coldness.
example_en: He got a fever caused by extreme coldness.

definition: overbearing management; domineering or haughty ruling over others.
example_en: The people grew weary of the domineering rule.

definition: the opening at the lower of urethral passage, through which urine is discharged from the body.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಮೇಹನದ್ವಾರದ ಬಳಿ ಊತ ಇರುವುದನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor noticed swelling near the urethral opening.

definition: the heat, warmth of the summer season.
example_en: People were distressed by the summer's intense heat.

definition: open; opened; split.
example_en: His clear, open speech was heard by everyone.

definition: a man who performs tricks on a bamboo shaft; an acrobat.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಳೆಕಾರ ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಸರತ್ತು ತೋರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: At the festival the acrobat performed tricks on a bamboo shaft.

definition: a lending of money.
example_en: Lending money was common among friends.

definition: to talk roughly from anger.
example_en: She talked roughly to her husband out of jealousy.

definition: a lump of mud.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಮಣ್ಣಂಗಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಆಟ ಆಡಿದರು.
example_en: The children played holding lumps of mud in their hands.

definition: want of taste for art or aesthetics; lack of quality or qualities of imagination, artistic nature.

definition: the creeper Citrullus vulgaris of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The Citrullus vulgaris creeper climbed over the fence.

definition: the deepest inaccessible level of the psyche in which are present in dynamic state repressed impulses and memories.
example: ಮನೋವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಅಜಾಗೃತ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Psychologists study the unconscious mind.

definition: a weapon or missile meant to be thrown at.
example_en: The soldiers threw missiles at the enemies.

definition: the annual plant Raphanus sativus of Brassicaceae family; radish plant.
example_en: Mother made radish curry.

definition: a square piece of cotton, linen, silk, etc., usu. carried in the pocket for wiping one's face, hands, etc.; a handkerchief.
example: ಅವನು ಜೇಬಿನಿಂದ ಕರವಸ್ತ್ರ ತೆಗೆದು ಬೆವರು ಒರೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: He took out a handkerchief from his pocket and wiped his sweat.

definition: the long-necked, web-footed goose, Anser indicus of Anatidae family, with white head that has a black stripe, noted for its ability to fly over a height of 18,000 ft; a bar-headed goose.
example_en: The bar-headed goose flies over high mountains.

definition: prestige - a) the power to impress or influence others, as because of success, wealth, etc.; b) reputation based on brilliance of achievement, character, etc.; renown.
example_en: His prestige was well known throughout the town.

definition: to move along the surface of a body with pressure; to rub.
example: ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೈಯನ್ನು ಕೀಱಿ ಗಾಯ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡ.
example_en: He rubbed his hand on the stone and hurt himself.

definition: to serve - a) to do services or duties for; give service to; b) to give obedience and reverent honour to.
example_en: The servant was serving his master with reverence.

definition: an act of cheating.
example_en: His act of cheating in the business angered everyone.

definition: to be depressed, depressed; to sag (down).
example_en: The ground sagged down due to the rain.

definition: to sing a song.
example_en: The child sang the song learnt at school.

definition: any large hog or boar.
example_en: A huge boar was roaming about in the forest.

definition: a rounded, protruding lump, as the fleshy mass on the back; a hump.
example: ಎತ್ತಿನ ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹೊಱಡು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a big hump on the ox's back.

definition: to cause to understand; to help one know; to inform.
example_en: The teacher made the students understand the lesson well.

definition: an old, elderly or respectable, honourable man.
example_en: The village elder was held in high esteem by everyone.

definition: name of a deity.
example_en: They worship Jokumara as the village deity.

definition: Goddess Pārvati.
example_en: The devotees prayed to Goddess Parvati and observed the vow.

definition: a 'X' mark used to denote that a particular word, sentence or portion of a written passage is deleted, cancelled or disapproved.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ತಪ್ಪು ಉತ್ತರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಟು ಹಾಕಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher put a cross mark on the wrong answer.

definition: to shake (a piece of cloth, bag, etc.) off vehemently as to take the dust out.
example_en: The grandmother shook the saree to remove the dust.

definition: the quality or fact of being related to the absolute Truth or beatitude.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಬೋಧನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾರಮಾರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯ ಆಳವಾದ ಅರ್ಥ ಅಡಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A deep meaning of the quality of absolute truth was hidden in the teacher's teaching.

definition: a room for defecation or urination; a toilet.
example_en: There was a toilet behind the house.

definition: fatigued; weary; tired; worn out.
example_en: Having worked all day, he became fatigued.

definition: to make vigorous or active; invigorate; to enliven.
example_en: Those words invigorated the patient.

definition: a stage for presenting dramas, in an open area; an open-air theatre.
example_en: The drama was staged at the open-air theatre.

definition: to joint (another person); to become a companion to.
example_en: He joined a merchant as a companion on the way.

definition: the quality of being brave; boldness; bravery.
example_en: The queen led the army with her boldness.

definition: anything that has thick growth of hairs or bristles on the body, as sheep, boar, etc.
example_en: A hairy, bristled animal was seen in the forest.

definition: to rule, govern a town.
example_en: That king ruled over the distant land.

definition: dizziness caused by spinning oneself or reeling of the head.
example_en: Spinning quickly, he became dizzy and fell down.

definition: a Vaiṣṇava devotee.
example_en: The Vaishnava devotee goes to the temple every day.

definition: a medium-sized, saddle-horse.
example_en: They use that medium-sized saddle-horse for riding.

definition: (pl.) the eight main points of the compass; all the eight directions.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆಶಾಷ್ಟಕದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಣೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The ancient texts contain a description of the eight main directions.
